headline: 財長貝森特評論不被看好
context: 衛報一篇評論指出，外界對美國財政部長貝森特（Scott Bessent）能否處理川普留下的關稅、伊朗制裁與龐大國債問題，普遍不太樂觀。這篇評論還拿他跟二戰盟軍統帥艾森豪相比，來對照他目前的處境有多艱難。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: There’s little optimism about treasury secretary’s ability to handle Trump’s tariffs, Iran sanctions and colossal US debt History remembers Gen Dwight Eisenhower , the supreme commander of the allied forces in Europe during the second world war, for his role in the D-day invasion of Normandy. Whether Scott Bessent will achieve similar posterity as the face of the “economic D-day” in Iran remains to be seen. The US treasury secretary, already trying to manage a $40tn national debt pile, this week took charge of Donald Trump ’s effort to reverse-engineer his war of choice. Whereas the US would typically take on an adversary with diplomacy, sanctions and military force, in that order, the US president started with a six-month bombing campaign and now hopes that economic isolation can finish the job. 財長貝森特評論不被看好

（這是一篇評論）衛報一篇評論指出，外界對美國財政部長貝森特（Scott Bessent）能否處理川普留下的關稅、伊朗制裁與龐大國債問題，普遍不太樂觀。

這篇評論還拿他跟二戰盟軍統帥艾森豪相比，來對照他目前的處境有多艱難。

—— 本則來自 The Guardian，2026 年 8 月 29 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。

voice_text: 這是一篇評論。有評論觀察到，外界對美國財政部長貝森特，能不能處理好川普留下的關稅、伊朗制裁跟龐大國債問題，普遍不太樂觀。文章甚至拿他跟二戰時期的盟軍統帥艾森豪相比，來說明他現在的處境有多艱難。
